notes: Type-led: no text ever stands on a picture, so every slot may be empty.

The accent is used as large type (wordmark, hovered service name, the band's telephone). A pale accent is deepened in its own hue until it reads 3.2:1 on the ground (law1's yellow #fdce32 becomes a dark gold).
A client ground that is white cannot carry the reference's brighter quotation zone; the zone goes 5 % toward the ink instead.
A long brand name is set smaller so that it stays on one line (clinic1, 30 letters in four words: about 46 px at 1440 and 12 px at 390, computed from the rule, not measured).
The opening photograph is cropped to the window on a phone (up to half its width is cut).
drops (as written): media.screens, media.phones, media.video, media.made
drops (as written): links[].d (the links stand as a column in the foot, titles only)
drops (as written): catalogue.groups[].h and catalogue.groups[].img when the catalogue is priced
drops (as written): features when an unpriced catalogue names the same services (the catalogue's groups and items are shown instead)
drops (as written): photographs beyond the four band slots, the steps' own and the portraits (never looped)
drops (as written): hero.kicker except as the line in the foot
drops (as written): foot.text when place or contact give phone, email or address
motif (as written): none (the client's own photographs only; one opens the page, others stand as wide bands over their text)

best_with: 1 landscape photograph at least 1600 wide and 3:2 or wider for the first screen; 1 wide photograph of the people (from 1000 wide) over the team; 1 of the door or building over the contact block; square or upright portraits from 200 px (shown 89x118); one wide photograph per step when the steps carry pictures
